step1_analysis.description: A ring oscillator-based VCO featuring a built-in compensation circuit to minimize delay variations caused by supply fluctuations. It uses complementary control voltages to tune the oscillation frequency while maintaining low supply sensitivity.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Self-Regulating VCO With Low Supply Sensitivity

oscillation_frequency.description: Operating frequency of the VCO at nominal control voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay per stage ~ C_load / gm. With W=5u, L=0.5u, C_load ~ 25fF, gm ~ 1.35mA/V. Delay ~ 18ps. For a 3-stage ring, freq = 1 / (2 * 3 * delay) ~ 9 GHz. However, parasitic caps and the complex compensation network will significantly lower this.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The netlist uses L=0.5um which is larger than the 130nm minimum, making it comparable to or slightly slower than the original 0.35um paper's 900MHz.

supply_sensitivity.description: Percentage change in oscillation frequency per 1% change in supply voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated by measuring frequency at VDD=1.8V and VDD=1.818V, then calculating ((f2-f1)/f1)/0.01.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The self-regulating architecture should keep this value very low, similar to the paper's reported 0.15%.

kvco.description: VCO tuning gain (change in frequency per volt of control voltage).

sky130_expected.calculation: Measured by changing V_CTRL from 0.9V to 1.2V and calculating delta_f / 0.3V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical ring oscillators have a wide tuning range, resulting in a high KVCO.

power_consumption.description: Average power drawn from the supply during steady-state oscillation.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_avg. With 3 stages and W=5u, average current is roughly 1-3mA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard power consumption for a multi-stage ring oscillator in 130nm at 1.8V.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise at 600-kHz offset from the carrier frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Requires PNOISE analysis, which is not standard in basic ngspice transient.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be in the same ballpark as the paper, but depends heavily on device flicker noise parameters in SKY130.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure VCO oscillation frequency, power consumption, supply sensitivity, and KVCO tuning gain.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMOS Self-Regulating VCO Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 B F GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 A E VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 C A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 E C VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 F D E GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 D B D GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 B V_CTRL_BAR A VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 D E C VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 E V_CTRL_BAR E VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 A V_CTRL B GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCTRL V_CTRL 0 0.9
VCTRLB V_CTRL_BAR 0 0.9

* Initial conditions to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(A)=0 v(C)=1.8 v(E)=0 v(B)=0 v(D)=1.8 v(F)=0

.control
  * 1. Nominal Frequency and Power
  tran 1p 100n uic
  meas tran t1 trig v(A) val=0.9 rise=5
  meas tran t2 trig v(A) val=0.9 rise=10
  let freq_nom = 5 / (t2 - t1)
  
  meas tran v_max max v(A)
  meas tran v_min min v(A)
  let v_swing = v_max - v_min
  
  meas tran pwr_integ integ i(VVDD) from=t1 to=t2
  let power = -1.8 * pwr_integ / (t2 - t1)
  
  * 2. Supply Sensitivity (1% VDD increase)
  alter VVDD 1.818
  tran 1p 100n uic
  meas tran t3 trig v(A) val=0.9 rise=5
  meas tran t4 trig v(A) val=0.9 rise=10
  let freq_high_vdd = 5 / (t4 - t3)
  let supply_sens = ((freq_high_vdd - freq_nom) / freq_nom) / 0.01
  
  * 3. Tuning Range (KVCO)
  alter VVDD 1.8
  alter VCTRL 1.2
  alter VCTRLB 0.6
  tran 1p 100n uic
  meas tran t5 trig v(A) val=0.9 rise=5
  meas tran t6 trig v(A) val=0.9 rise=10
  let freq_tune = 5 / (t6 - t5)
  let kvco = (freq_tune - freq_nom) / (1.2 - 0.9)
  
  print freq_nom power v_swing supply_sens kvco
  quit
.endc
.end
